subject.title: Beta blocker: codex - app-server binding can exceed plugin-state limit

question: Must the bounded-fingerprint fix in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/104504 land before the next beta is cut?
rationale: The defect and narrow fix boundary are established, but the protected beta-blocker designation makes release inclusion an explicit maintainer decision.

options.title: Land Before Next Beta
options.body: Require the linked fix and a successful plugin-heavy Codex smoke before cutting the next beta.

options.title: Defer And Remove Blocker
options.body: Ship without the fix only after explicitly accepting that sufficiently plugin-heavy Codex installations may fail before producing a response.

recommendation.title: Land Before Next Beta
recommendation.body: Require the linked fix and a successful plugin-heavy Codex smoke before cutting the next beta.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced the current binding fingerprint implementation and is the strongest history-backed owner for the Codex lifecycle and release disposition.
